subject: MAP: Dedicated GPU pool — stakeholder roster, throughput targets & timeline
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@pacificanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Dedicated GPU pool — stakeholder roster, throughput targets & timeline

Hi Jordan — thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, I put together a starter Mutual Action Plan so we have a single place to track roles, throughput goals, milestones, and procurement checkpoints. Quick context up front: our MAP is scoped for a dedicated GPU pool (Nvidia H100 equivalent), target steady-state throughput of ~1.2M tokens/day with 95th pct latency SLOs at 150ms per token for inference pathways.

Attached: MAP_v1.xlsx (draft), throughput-targets.pdf (worked example), and a short playbook.

As a next step I want to confirm stakeholders and a short evaluation cadence (2-week evaluation -> 2-week canary -> target rollout). Can you confirm who will be your technical owner for capacity testing and who will own procurement/contract? Suggested Redwood attendees below.

Suggested Redwood roster:
- Tessa Morgan (EM, Strategic Sales) — MAP lead, timeline owner
- Marissa Cole (Solutions Architect) — capacity planning, perf validation
- Ben Carter (Customer Success) — canary + rollout ops
- Rishi Malhotra (Legal/Commercial) — pricing & procurement checkpoints (looped as needed)

Requested Pacific Analytics roster:
- Primary technical owner (capacity testing)
- Procurement lead (PO/contract)
- Security/Compliance reviewer (if SOC2 evidence required)

Can you confirm ownership and availability for a 45-min MAP sync on Tue or Wed this week? I put a provisional slot on Wed 6/23 10:00-10:45 PT — happy to move.

Thanks — look forward to lining up the evaluation plan.

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Engagement Lead, Redwood Inference
attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), throughput-targets.pdf (pdf), redwood-dedicated-playbook.pdf (pdf)

Thanks Tessa — appreciate the clear plan and the draft MAP. Quick answers from our side:
- Technical owner: Jordan Lee (me) — I will lead capacity testing and hand off to our infra team for sustained runs.
- Procurement: Ayesha Raman (cc'd) — she'll handle contract and PO questions.
- Security reviewer: John Park (secops) — I'll add him after we confirm what evidence is needed (SOC2 + network diagrams likely).

Wed 6/23 10:00 PT works for me. If you need John on the call, I can see if he can join (preferred to get a quick read on evidence scope).

Also — quick question: can your MAP include a simple pass/fail criteria for the initial perf eval (e.g., 95th pct latency <200ms at 75% baseline throughput)? That will help us decide go/no-go.

Jordan
Jordan Lee
Head of Platform, Pacific Analytics

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Dedicated GPU pool — stakeholder roster, throughput targets & timeline

Jordan / Tessa — thanks for the quick responses. A few practical notes from the SA side before the sync:

- Evaluation phases (what I'll run):
  * Week 1 (lab run): sustained throughput ramp to 75% target across representative queries (we'll run your 10 canonical prompts + two stress patterns). Pass criterion: 95th pct latency < 200ms at 75% load.
  * Week 2 (soak): 48-hour soak at 85% baseline to validate stability (memory/KV cache behavior).
  * Canary: 1-week canary in your dev cluster with production-ish traffic shaping.

- Data we need from you before weekday sync:
  1) A small sample of representative request traces (sanitized) or a short prompt set (10 prompts)
  2) Preferred model variant (we recommended an 8-bit quantized Llama-style model or a 16-bit open backbone)
  3) Network egress constraints / IP allowlists for private deployment (if you plan Private mode)

I added a short MAP agenda to the HubSpot link (see calendar invite). I'll walk through the evaluation fixtures and a simple reporting template so procurement has visibility.

Ben — can you add a short note on rollback/mitigation steps for the canary (2-3 bullets) in the meeting?

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Perfect — thanks all for the confirmations. Quick summary / agreed actions from Redwood side before tomorrow's sync (6/23 10:00 PT):

1) Redwood will provide:
   - Final MAP v1 (updated with pass/fail criteria and milestone dates) — attached (MAP_v1.xlsx)
   - Test fixture template + 10 canonical prompts (attached in throughput-targets.pdf)
   - Canary rollback checklist (short doc — included in playbook)

2) Pacific Analytics to provide before sync:
   - Sanitized sample traces or prompt set (see Marissa's list)
   - Confirmation of model variant preference
   - Procurement contact details (Ayesha — can you share PO process and standard SLA asks)

3) Timeline (tentative):
   - 6/23: MAP sync and alignment (this Wed)
   - 6/24-7/07: Lab perf evaluation (2 weeks)
   - 7/08-7/14: Soak/canary prep + procurement PR review
   - 7/15: Canary start

If that looks right I'll lock the HubSpot entry and send the calendar invite to procurement and security. Rishi — feel free to review the pricing checkpoints I included; I'll follow up with a short note if we need redlines.

Looking forward to the call.

— Tessa
